text:
oncall-bot: [PAGER] sev=sev2 service=embedder detected error-rate spike > threshold. Pagering @alex.m @lena.c. Incident link: https://incidents.internal/3312345678

alex.m: I'm on call, ack. hopping on infra. investigating root cause now.

oncall-bot: signature detected: kv_lookup_timeout increased ~8x across embedder workers.

lena.c: noticed a rollout for embedder-config at 03:12 that changed TTL from 5m -> 30s. looks suspicious.

alex.m: yep that's the diff I see. likely causing cache thrash and overloading origin. planning immediate rollback.

alex.m: Run: ```infractl rollout revert embedder-config/2026-03-17-0312```

lena.c: executing rollback now, will tail logs. @ops-bot can you start a trace on the top failing requests?

ops-bot: rollback job 9876 started. traces enabled for request signature "embed/v1/generate". ETA ~90s.

samir: customer-impact quick note: error rate peaked ~12% for text-gen/embeddings calls, ~4k failed requests in 20m window. two enterprise tenants had higher error spike, CS alerted.

jamie: thanks, looping in CSMs and support for customer outreach. I'll draft comms after we confirm stabilization.

lena.c: rollback completed. error rate dropping — current error-rate <0.5%. KV miss rate back to baseline.

alex.m: good. capture metrics + traces to the incident page, please. I'll open postmortem and create action items.

alex.m: Action items (initial):
- A1 owner:@ricardo size:small — add rollout gating + canary check for embedder-config TTL changes (block full rollout until <1% error on canary).
- A2 owner:@samir size:medium — add alerting for kv miss surge and automated rollback trigger (3d estimate to prototype).
- A3 owner:@jamie size:large — customer comms + credits + runbook update + postmortem write-up (tie to Q2 reliability OKR).
- A4 owner:@lena.c size:medium — investigate kvclient hotpaths and backpressure, push patch if needed.

alex.m: Prioritization: sev2 incident -> A1/A2 should be in next sprint, A3 prioritized for immediate follow-up (customer-facing), A4 next-in-line. Recommend A1 as high priority gating to prevent recurrence.

ricardo: taking A1, will open a PR with gating and canary pipeline today. ETA: PR by EOD.

samir: taking A2, will break into sub-tasks and post estimates (expect ~3 dev-days + 1 day ops integration).

jamie: scheduling postmortem meeting for tomorrow 10:00 PT, inviting SRE/infra/eng/CS/support. Creating the incident postmortem doc now.

alex.m: please create Jira tickets and link them on the incident page. I'll add remediation deadlines and mark owners. Also add regression tests in CI for TTL-config changes.

lena.c: uploaded KV client logs, traces, and the diff for the config change to the incident page. added heap of screenshots.

ops-bot: postmortem created: https://incidents.internal/pm/3312345678 — meeting invite sent.

alex.m: thanks all. If no regressions we'll close oncall handoff in 30m. Follow-ups tracked in Jira and tied to Q2 roadmap: reliability -> rollout-safety. :thumbsup:
